facts.fact: MISA Lesotho states that Lesotho has no access to information law, and that an Access to Information Bill initiated in 2021 by the National Reforms Authority is still awaiting parliament's approval.

MISA Lesotho says the Computer Crime and Cybersecurity Bill, first presented in 2021 and dismissed by the National Assembly in September 2021, was tabled again in the National Assembly in 2024 by Minister Moorosi in almost its original form.

LSO.note: The document says nothing about police station records.

facts.fact: MISA Lesotho and the Transformation Resource Center made submissions on the Computer Crime and Cybersecurity Bill before the National Assembly's Portfolio Committee in September 2024, and MISA had earlier made submissions to the communications ministers and to the committee in the Tenth and Eleventh Parliaments.

LSO.note: The document gives no rural electricity access figure.
